title: Étale restriction of coefficient duals
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $U\to X$ an étale morphism, and $F$ any sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small étale site of $X$. Let $\Lambda_X$ and $\Lambda_U$ denote the constant coefficient sheaves [def-constructible-constant], equivalently the monoidal units. Then $(F^\vee)|_U\cong (F|_U)^\vee$, where $F^\vee=\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$ and restriction means étale inverse image.

proof.text: Identify the small étale site of U with the slice of the small étale site of X at the object U. For an object V of this slice, the iterated slice (X_et/U)/V is canonically equivalent to X_et/V.

Describe sections of the coefficient internal Hom over V as the module of morphisms between the two sheaves restricted to X_et/V. The preceding slice equivalence therefore identifies the restrictions of internal Hom with internal Hom of the restrictions, compatibly with further restriction maps. This description follows from the tensor-Hom adjunction applied to the free coefficient sheaf represented by V.

The unit restricts to the unit. Transport the internal Hom identification across the slice-site equivalence to obtain the coefficient-dual isomorphism. No local constancy or finiteness is used and no assertion is made about non-étale pullback.

theorem nonempty_etaleDualRestrictionIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.hom).obj
      ((ihom F).obj (𝟙_ _)) ≅
      (ihom ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.hom).obj F)).obj (𝟙_ _))
